```shellscript
#!/usr/bin/env bash

CONFIG_FILE="$HOME/.uhj-generic-audio.conf"

# Main dialog menu with hidden options
show_menu() {
    while true; do
        choice=$(dialog --title "UHJ-Pi Audio System" --menu "Choose your mode:" 0 0 2 \
            "1" "Live Input Mode" \
            "2" "Player Mode" 2>&1 >/dev/tty)
        
        case $choice in
            "1")
                echo "Starting Live Input Mode..."
                break  # Exit the menu loop and proceed with live input setup
                ;;
            "2")
                echo "Starting Player Mode..."
                exec "$HOME/UHJ-Pi/start-pla.sh"
                ;;
            "b"|"B")
                echo "Starting Bluetooth headtracker setup..."
                exec /usr/local/bin/ble-ht
                ;;
            "r"|"R")
                if dialog --title "Reset System" --yesno "This will perform a COMPLETE system reset.\n\nAre you sure?" 0 0; then
                    echo "Starting system reset..."
                    exec /usr/local/bin/reset-pi
                fi
                ;;
            "")
                # User cancelled or pressed ESC
                echo "Exiting..."
                exit 0
                ;;
        esac
    done
}

# Run the menu
show_menu

echo "Starting UHJ-Pi live input audio setup..."

show_device_info() {
    local card_num=$1
    local card_name=$2
    local device_type=$3  # "input" or "output"
    
    echo "✓ Selected: $card_name"
    
    # Show only relevant channel count for the device type
    if [ "$device_type" = "input" ]; then
        # Get input channel count from stream info (most reliable)
        local input_channels=$(cat "/proc/asound/card$card_num/stream0" 2>/dev/null | grep -A 20 "Capture:" | grep "Channels:" | head -1 | grep -o "[0-9]*" || echo "2")
        if [ -n "$input_channels" ] && [ "$input_channels" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "  Inputs: $input_channels channels"
        fi
    elif [ "$device_type" = "output" ]; then
        # Get output channel count from stream info (most reliable)
        local output_channels=$(cat "/proc/asound/card$card_num/stream0" 2>/dev/null | grep -A 20 "Playback:" | grep "Channels:" | head -1 | grep -o "[0-9]*" || echo "2")
        if [ -n "$output_channels" ] && [ "$output_channels" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "  Outputs: $output_channels channels"
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
}

show_input_options() {
    local card_num=$1
    local card_name=$2
    echo "  Available inputs:"
    
    # Get input options from amixer
    local input_options=()
    local control_info=$(amixer -c "$card_num" scontents 2>/dev/null)
    
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ ^Simple\ mixer\ control\ \'([^\']+)\' ]]; then
            local control_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            # Check if this control has capture volume
            if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then
                # Check if it has capture channels (not just playback)
                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$control_name'" | grep -q "Capture channels"; then
                    input_options+=("$control_name")
                fi
            fi
        fi
    done <<< "$control_info"
    
    if [ ${#input_options[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        for option in "${input_options[@]}"; do
            echo "    • $option"
        done
    else
        echo "    • No software-controllable inputs detected"
    fi
}

show_output_options() {
    local card_num=$1
    local card_name=$2
    echo "  Available outputs:"
    
    # Get output options from aplay
    output_devices=$(aplay -l | grep "card $card_num:" | sed 's/.*card [0-9]*: \([^,]*\).*/\1/')
    if [ -n "$output_devices" ]; then
        echo "$output_devices" | while read -r device; do
            echo "    • $device"
        done
    else
        echo "    • No output devices detected"
    fi
}

detect_generic_devices() {
    input_card=""
    input_name=""
    output_card=""
    output_name=""

    echo "=== Input Device Setup ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Step 1: Connect the USB audio device you want to use for input"
    read -p "Press Enter when your input device is connected..." _
    echo "Scanning for audio devices..."
    sleep 2

    # Prefer a device that has capture capability
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*\[([^]]+)\]: ]]; then
            local card_num="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            local card_name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            if arecord -l | grep -q "card $card_num:"; then
                input_card="$card_num"; input_name="$card_name"; break
            fi
        fi
    done < /proc/asound/cards

    # Check if any input device was found
    if [ -z "$input_card" ]; then
        echo "❌ No input audio device found!"
        echo "Please connect a USB audio device and try again."
        echo ""
        read -p "Press Enter to retry..." _
        detect_generic_devices  # Recursive call to retry
        return
    fi
    echo "✓ Using input: hw:$input_card ($input_name)"; show_device_info "$input_card" "$input_name" "input"

    # Detect available input pairs and their controls FIRST
    input_source=""
    input_control=""
    input_pair=""
    has_input_gain=0
    
    if command -v amixer >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Detecting input options on $input_name..."
        
        # Parse amixer output to find input pairs with capture volume
        input_options=()
        control_info=$(amixer -c "$input_card" scontents 2>/dev/null)
        
        # Look for controls with capture volume (cvolume)
        seen_controls=()
        while IFS= read -r line; do
            if [[ $line =~ ^Simple\ mixer\ control\ \'([^\']+)\' ]]; then
                full_control_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
                control_name=$(echo "$full_control_name" | sed 's/,[0-9]*$//')
                
                # Skip if we've already processed this control name
                if [[ " ${seen_controls[@]} " =~ " ${control_name} " ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                
                # Skip PCM controls - these are routing/processing, not physical inputs
                if [[ "$control_name" == "PCM" ]] || [[ "$control_name" == *"PCM"* ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                
                # Skip Speaker controls - these are output controls, not input sources
                if [[ "$control_name" == "Speaker" ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                
                # Skip enum-only controls that are routing selectors (like "PCM Capture Source")
                # but keep physical inputs like "IEC958 In" even if they're enum
                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "Capabilities.*enum" && ! echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then
                    # Allow IEC958 In (SPDIF) as it's a physical input
                    if [[ "$control_name" != "IEC958 In" ]]; then
                        continue
                    fi
                fi
                
                # Check if this control has capture volume (cvolume) - needed for input faders
                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then
                    # Check if it has capture channels (not just playback)
                    if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "Capture channels"; then
                        # Get channel info to distinguish between stereo/mono
                        local channel_info=$(echo "$control_info" | grep -A 5 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep "Capture channels:" | head -1)
                        if echo "$channel_info" | grep -q "Front Left - Front Right"; then
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        elif echo "$channel_info" | grep -q "Mono"; then
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        else
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        fi
                    fi
                fi
            fi
        done <<< "$control_info"
        
        # Always ask user to choose if multiple options available
        if [ ${#input_options[@]} -gt 1 ]; then
            echo "Multiple input options detected:"
            for i in "${!input_options[@]}"; do
                echo "  $((i+1)). ${input_options[$i]}"
            done
            echo ""
            read -p "Choose input source (1-${#input_options[@]}): " choice
            if [[ "$choice" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$choice" -ge 1 ] && [ "$choice" -le ${#input_options[@]} ]; then
                input_source="${input_options[$((choice-1))]}"
            else
                input_source="${input_options[0]}"
            fi
        elif [ ${#input_options[@]} -eq 1 ]; then
            input_source="${input_options[0]}"
            echo "✓ Selected input: ${input_source}"
        fi
        
        # Use the selected input source directly
        input_source="$input_source"
        
        if [ -n "$input_source" ]; then
            # Use the selected input source for gain control
            input_control="$input_source"
            input_pair="$input_source"
            has_input_gain=1
            echo "✓ Selected input: $input_source"
            
            # Check if the input control (PCM or fallback) has a mute/capture switch
            has_input_mute=0
            if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$input_control'" | grep -q "cswitch"; then
                has_input_mute=1
                echo "✓ Input mute control detected on $input_control"
            else
                echo "• No input mute control detected on $input_control"
            fi
            
            # Actually switch ALSA to use the selected input source
            echo "Switching to $input_source input..."
            
            # Find the capture source control name dynamically
            capture_source_control=$(amixer -c "$input_card" scontents 2>/dev/null | grep -i "capture source" | head -1 | sed "s/.*'\([^']*\)'.*/\1/")
            if [ -n "$capture_source_control" ]; then
                echo "Setting $capture_source_control to: $input_source"
                amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$capture_source_control" "$input_source" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            fi
            
            # Then enable capture on that input
            echo "Enabling capture on: $input_source"
            amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$input_source" cap >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$input_source" 80% >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            echo "✓ Input switched to $input_source"
        else
            echo "• No input volume controls detected"
            has_input_gain=0
            has_input_mute=0
        fi
        
        # For cards with only physical controls (no software gain), don't use ALSA mute
        # Let the synth handle mute instead
        if [ "$has_input_gain" -eq 0 ]; then
            has_input_mute=0
            echo "• Using synth mute (no software input controls detected)"
        fi
    fi

    echo ""
    echo "=== Output Device Setup ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Step 2: Connect the USB audio device you want to use for output"
    echo "(or just press Enter if using the same device for input and output)"
    read -p "Press Enter when your output device is connected..." _
    echo "Scanning for output interface..."; sleep 2
    echo "Available devices:"; cat /proc/asound/cards; echo ""; sleep 1

    # Prefer a device that has playback capability and is not the chosen input
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*\[([^]]+)\]: ]]; then
            local card_num="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            local card_name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            if [ "$card_num" != "$input_card" ] && aplay -l | grep -q "card $card_num:"; then
                output_card="$card_num"; output_name="$card_name"; break
            fi
        fi
    done < /proc/asound/cards

    # If none found, use the same card for both
    if [ -z "$output_card" ]; then
        output_card="$input_card"; output_name="$input_name"
        echo "No separate output found; using same card for input and output"
    fi

    echo "✓ Using output: hw:$output_card ($output_name)"; show_device_info "$output_card" "$output_name" "output"


    echo "INPUT_CARD=$input_card" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_NAME=$input_name" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_SOURCE=$input_source" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_CONTROL=$input_control" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_PAIR=$input_pair" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "OUTPUT_CARD=$output_card" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "OUTPUT_NAME=$output_name" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "HAS_INPUT_GAIN=$has_input_gain" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "HAS_INPUT_MUTE=$has_input_mute" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo ""
    echo "=== Configuration Complete ==="
    echo "✓ Input:  hw:$input_card ($input_name)"
    if [ -n "$input_source" ]; then
        echo "  Source: $input_source"
    fi
    echo "✓ Output: hw:$output_card ($output_name)"
    if [ "$has_input_gain" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✓ Input gain control: $input_control"
    else
        echo "• No input gain control detected"
    fi
    if [ "$has_input_mute" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✓ Input mute control: $input_control"
    else
        echo "• No input mute control detected"
    fi
    echo ""
}

echo "Preparing audio system..."
killall jackd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
killall sclang >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 2

detect_generic_devices
source "$CONFIG_FILE"

echo "Starting audio system..."

jackd -P75 -d alsa -C hw:$INPUT_CARD -P hw:$OUTPUT_CARD -r 44100 -p 1024 -n 3 -S >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 3
if ! pgrep jackd > /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Audio system failed to start."
    exit 1
fi
echo "✓ Audio system ready"

# Set and export capability flags and input details to the app environment
HAS_INPUT_GAIN=$has_input_gain
HAS_INPUT_MUTE=$has_input_mute
INPUT_CARD=$input_card
INPUT_SOURCE=$input_source
INPUT_CONTROL=$input_control
INPUT_PAIR=$input_pair
export HAS_INPUT_GAIN
export HAS_INPUT_MUTE
export INPUT_CARD
export INPUT_SOURCE
export INPUT_CONTROL
export INPUT_PAIR


# Launch SuperCollider application
echo "Starting application..."
exec sclang "$HOME/UHJ-Pi/supercollider/app/UHJ_v23_GEN_PAIR.scd"
```

```shellscript
                    # Allow IEC958 In (SPDIF) as it's a physical input
                    if [[ "$control_name" != "IEC958 In" ]]; then
                        continue
                    fi
                fi
                
                # Check if this control has capture volume (cvolume) - needed for input faders
                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then
                    # Check if it has capture channels (not just playback)
                    if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "Capture channels"; then
                        # Get channel info to distinguish between stereo/mono
                        local channel_info=$(echo "$control_info" | grep -A 5 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep "Capture channels:" | head -1)
                        if echo "$channel_info" | grep -q "Front Left - Front Right"; then
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        elif echo "$channel_info" | grep -q "Mono"; then
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        else
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        fi
                    fi
                fi
            fi
        done <<< "$control_info"
        
        # Always ask user to choose if multiple options available
        if [ ${#input_options[@]} -gt 1 ]; then
            echo "Multiple input options detected:"
            for i in "${!input_options[@]}"; do
                echo "  $((i+1)). ${input_options[$i]}"
            done
            echo ""
            read -p "Choose input source (1-${#input_options[@]}): " choice
            if [[ "$choice" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$choice" -ge 1 ] && [ "$choice" -le ${#input_options[@]} ]; then
                input_source="${input_options[$((choice-1))]}"
            else
                input_source="${input_options[0]}"
            fi
        elif [ ${#input_options[@]} -eq 1 ]; then
            input_source="${input_options[0]}"
            echo "✓ Selected input: ${input_source}"
        fi
        
        # Use the selected input source directly
        input_source="$input_source"
        
        if [ -n "$input_source" ]; then
            # Use the selected input source for gain control
            input_control="$input_source"
            input_pair="$input_source"
            has_input_gain=1
            echo "✓ Selected input: $input_source"
            
            # Check if the input control (PCM or fallback) has a mute/capture switch
            has_input_mute=0
            if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$input_control'" | grep -q "cswitch"; then
                has_input_mute=1
                echo "✓ Input mute control detected on $input_control"
            else
                echo "• No input mute control detected on $input_control"
            fi
            
            # Actually switch ALSA to use the selected input source
            echo "Switching to $input_source input..."
            
            # Find the capture source control name dynamically
            capture_source_control=$(amixer -c "$input_card" scontents 2>/dev/null | grep -i "capture source" | head -1 | sed "s/.*'\([^']*\)'.*/\1/")
            if [ -n "$capture_source_control" ]; then
                echo "Setting $capture_source_control to: $input_source"
                amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$capture_source_control" "$input_source" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            fi
            
            # Then enable capture on that input
            echo "Enabling capture on: $input_source"
            amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$input_source" cap >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$input_source" 80% >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            echo "✓ Input switched to $input_source"
        else
            echo "• No input volume controls detected"
            has_input_gain=0
            has_input_mute=0
        fi
        
        # For cards with only physical controls (no software gain), don't use ALSA mute
        # Let the synth handle mute instead
        if [ "$has_input_gain" -eq 0 ]; then
            has_input_mute=0
            echo "• Using synth mute (no software input controls detected)"
        fi
    fi

    echo ""
    echo "=== Output Device Setup ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Step 2: Connect the USB audio device you want to use for output"
    echo "(or just press Enter if using the same device for input and output)"
    read -p "Press Enter when your output device is connected..." _
    echo "Scanning for output interface..."; sleep 2
    echo "Available devices:"; cat /proc/asound/cards; echo ""; sleep 1

    # Prefer a device that has playback capability and is not the chosen input
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*\[([^]]+)\]: ]]; then
            local card_num="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            local card_name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            if [ "$card_num" != "$input_card" ] && aplay -l | grep -q "card $card_num:"; then
                output_card="$card_num"; output_name="$card_name"; break
            fi
        fi
    done < /proc/asound/cards

    # If none found, use the same card for both
    if [ -z "$output_card" ]; then
        output_card="$input_card"; output_name="$input_name"
        echo "No separate output found; using same card for input and output"
    fi

    echo "✓ Using output: hw:$output_card ($output_name)"; show_device_info "$output_card" "$output_name" "output"


    echo "INPUT_CARD=$input_card" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_NAME=$input_name" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_SOURCE=$input_source" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_CONTROL=$input_control" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_PAIR=$input_pair" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "OUTPUT_CARD=$output_card" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "OUTPUT_NAME=$output_name" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "HAS_INPUT_GAIN=$has_input_gain" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "HAS_INPUT_MUTE=$has_input_mute" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo ""
    echo "=== Configuration Complete ==="
    echo "✓ Input:  hw:$input_card ($input_name)"
    if [ -n "$input_source" ]; then
        echo "  Source: $input_source"
    fi
    echo "✓ Output: hw:$output_card ($output_name)"
    if [ "$has_input_gain" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✓ Input gain control: $input_control"
    else
        echo "• No input gain control detected"
    fi
    if [ "$has_input_mute" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✓ Input mute control: $input_control"
    else
        echo "• No input mute control detected"
    fi
    echo ""
}

echo "Preparing audio system..."
killall jackd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
killall sclang >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 2

detect_generic_devices
source "$CONFIG_FILE"

echo "Starting audio system..."

jackd -P75 -d alsa -C hw:$INPUT_CARD -P hw:$OUTPUT_CARD -r 44100 -p 1024 -n 3 -S >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 3
if ! pgrep jackd > /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Audio system failed to start."
    exit 1
fi
echo "✓ Audio system ready"

# Set and export capability flags and input details to the app environment
HAS_INPUT_GAIN=$has_input_gain
HAS_INPUT_MUTE=$has_input_mute
INPUT_CARD=$input_card
INPUT_SOURCE=$input_source
INPUT_CONTROL=$input_control
INPUT_PAIR=$input_pair
export HAS_INPUT_GAIN
export HAS_INPUT_MUTE
export INPUT_CARD
export INPUT_SOURCE
export INPUT_CONTROL
export INPUT_PAIR


# Launch SuperCollider application
echo "Starting application..."
exec sclang "$HOME/UHJ-Pi/supercollider/app/UHJ_v23_GEN_PAIR.scd"
```

```shellscript
#!/usr/bin/env bash

CONFIG_FILE="$HOME/.uhj-generic-audio.conf"

# Main dialog menu with hidden options
show_menu() {
    while true; do
        choice=$(dialog --no-lines --no-shadow --no-ok --no-cancel --title "UHJ-Pi Audio System" --menu "Choose your mode:" 0 0 2 \
            "1" "Live Input Mode" \
            "2" "Player Mode" 2>&1 >/dev/tty)
        
        case $choice in
            "1")
                echo "Starting Live Input Mode..."
                break  # Exit the menu loop and proceed with live input setup
                ;;
            "2")
                echo "Starting Player Mode..."
                exec "$HOME/UHJ-Pi/start-pla.sh"
                ;;
            "b"|"B")
                echo "Starting Bluetooth headtracker setup..."
                exec /usr/local/bin/ble-ht
                ;;
            "r"|"R")
                if dialog --title "Reset System" --yesno "This will perform a COMPLETE system reset.\n\nAre you sure?" 0 0; then
                    echo "Starting system reset..."
                    exec /usr/local/bin/reset-pi
                fi
                ;;
            "")
                # User cancelled or pressed ESC
                echo "Exiting..."
                exit 0
                ;;
        esac
    done
}

# Run the menu
show_menu

show_device_info() {
    local card_num=$1
    local card_name=$2
    local device_type=$3  # "input" or "output"
    
    echo "✓ Selected: $card_name"
    
    # Show only relevant channel count for the device type
    if [ "$device_type" = "input" ]; then
        # Get input channel count from stream info (most reliable)
        local input_channels=$(cat "/proc/asound/card$card_num/stream0" 2>/dev/null | grep -A 20 "Capture:" | grep "Channels:" | head -1 | grep -o "[0-9]*" || echo "2")
        if [ -n "$input_channels" ] && [ "$input_channels" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "  Inputs: $input_channels channels"
        fi
    elif [ "$device_type" = "output" ]; then
        # Get output channel count from stream info (most reliable)
        local output_channels=$(cat "/proc/asound/card$card_num/stream0" 2>/dev/null | grep -A 20 "Playback:" | grep "Channels:" | head -1 | grep -o "[0-9]*" || echo "2")
        if [ -n "$output_channels" ] && [ "$output_channels" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "  Outputs: $output_channels channels"
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
}

show_input_options() {
    local card_num=$1
    local card_name=$2
    echo "  Available inputs:"
    
    # Get input options from amixer
    local input_options=()
    local control_info=$(amixer -c "$card_num" scontents 2>/dev/null)
    
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ ^Simple\ mixer\ control\ \'([^\']+)\' ]]; then
            local control_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"

            if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then

                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$control_name'" | grep -q "Capture channels"; then
                    input_options+=("$control_name")
                fi
            fi
        fi
    done <<< "$control_info"
    
    if [ ${#input_options[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        for option in "${input_options[@]}"; do
            echo "    • $option"
        done
    else
        echo "    • No software-controllable inputs detected"
    fi
}

show_output_options() {
    local card_num=$1
    local card_name=$2
    echo "  Available outputs:"
    
    # Get output options from aplay
    output_devices=$(aplay -l | grep "card $card_num:" | sed 's/.*card [0-9]*: \([^,]*\).*/\1/')
    if [ -n "$output_devices" ]; then
        echo "$output_devices" | while read -r device; do
            echo "    • $device"
        done
    else

    fi
}

            if arecord -l | grep -q "card $card_num:"; then
```

```shellscript
# Run the menu
show_menu

echo "Starting UHJ-Pi live input audio setup..."

show_device_info() {
    local card_num=$1
    local card_name=$2
    local device_type=$3  # "input" or "output"
    
    echo "✓ Selected: $card_name"
    
    # Show only relevant channel count for the device type
    if [ "$device_type" = "input" ]; then
        # Get input channel count from stream info (most reliable)
        local input_channels=$(cat "/proc/asound/card$card_num/stream0" 2>/dev/null | grep -A 20 "Capture:" | grep "Channels:" | head -1 | grep -o "[0-9]*" || echo "2")
        if [ -n "$input_channels" ] && [ "$input_channels" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "  Inputs: $input_channels channels"
        fi
    elif [ "$device_type" = "output" ]; then
        # Get output channel count from stream info (most reliable)
        local output_channels=$(cat "/proc/asound/card$card_num/stream0" 2>/dev/null | grep -A 20 "Playback:" | grep "Channels:" | head -1 | grep -o "[0-9]*" || echo "2")
        if [ -n "$output_channels" ] && [ "$output_channels" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "  Outputs: $output_channels channels"
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
}

show_input_options() {
    local card_num=$1
    local card_name=$2
    echo "  Available inputs:"
    
    # Get input options from amixer
    local input_options=()
    local control_info=$(amixer -c "$card_num" scontents 2>/dev/null)
    
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ ^Simple\ mixer\ control\ \'([^\']+)\' ]]; then
            local control_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            # Check if this control has capture volume
            if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then
                # Check if it has capture channels (not just playback)
                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$control_name'" | grep -q "Capture channels"; then
                    input_options+=("$control_name")
                fi
            fi
        fi
    done <<< "$control_info"
    
    if [ ${#input_options[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        for option in "${input_options[@]}"; do
            echo "    • $option"
        done
    else
        echo "    • No software-controllable inputs detected"
    fi
}

show_output_options() {
    local card_num=$1
    local card_name=$2
    echo "  Available outputs:"
    
    # Get output options from aplay
    output_devices=$(aplay -l | grep "card $card_num:" | sed 's/.*card [0-9]*: \([^,]*\).*/\1/')
    if [ -n "$output_devices" ]; then
        echo "$output_devices" | while read -r device; do
            echo "    • $device"
        done
    else
        echo "    • No output devices detected"
    fi
}

detect_generic_devices() {
    input_card=""
    input_name=""
    output_card=""
    output_name=""

    echo "=== Input Device Setup ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Step 1: Connect the USB audio device you want to use for input"
    read -p "Press Enter when your input device is connected..." _
    echo "Scanning for audio devices..."
    sleep 2

    # Prefer a device that has capture capability
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*\[([^]]+)\]: ]]; then
            local card_num="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            local card_name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            if arecord -l | grep -q "card $card_num:"; then
                input_card="$card_num"; input_name="$card_name"; break
            fi
        fi
    done < /proc/asound/cards

    # Check if any input device was found
    if [ -z "$input_card" ]; then
        echo "❌ No input audio device found!"
        echo "Please connect a USB audio device and try again."
        echo ""
        read -p "Press Enter to retry..." _
        detect_generic_devices  # Recursive call to retry
        return
    fi
    echo "✓ Using input: hw:$input_card ($input_name)"; show_device_info "$input_card" "$input_name" "input"

    # Detect available input pairs and their controls FIRST
    input_source=""
    input_control=""
    input_pair=""
    has_input_gain=0
    
    if command -v amixer >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Detecting input options on $input_name..."
        
        # Parse amixer output to find input pairs with capture volume
        input_options=()
        control_info=$(amixer -c "$input_card" scontents 2>/dev/null)
        
        # Look for controls with capture volume (cvolume)
        seen_controls=()
        while IFS= read -r line; do
            if [[ $line =~ ^Simple\ mixer\ control\ \'([^\']+)\' ]]; then
                full_control_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
                control_name=$(echo "$full_control_name" | sed 's/,[0-9]*$//')
                
                # Skip if we've already processed this control name
                if [[ " ${seen_controls[@]} " =~ " ${control_name} " ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                
                # Skip PCM controls - these are routing/processing, not physical inputs
                if [[ "$control_name" == "PCM" ]] || [[ "$control_name" == *"PCM"* ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                
                # Skip Speaker controls - these are output controls, not input sources
                if [[ "$control_name" == "Speaker" ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                
                # Skip enum-only controls that are routing selectors (like "PCM Capture Source")
                # but keep physical inputs like "IEC958 In" even if they're enum
                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "Capabilities.*enum" && ! echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then
                    # Allow IEC958 In (SPDIF) as it's a physical input
                    if [[ "$control_name" != "IEC958 In" ]]; then
                        continue
                    fi
                fi
                
                # Check if this control has capture volume (cvolume) - needed for input faders
                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then
                    # Check if it has capture channels (not just playback)
                    if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "Capture channels"; then
                        # Get channel info to distinguish between stereo/mono
                        local channel_info=$(echo "$control_info" | grep -A 5 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep "Capture channels:" | head -1)
                        if echo "$channel_info" | grep -q "Front Left - Front Right"; then
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        elif echo "$channel_info" | grep -q "Mono"; then
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        else
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        fi
                    fi
                fi
            fi
        done <<< "$control_info"
        
        # Always ask user to choose if multiple options available
        if [ ${#input_options[@]} -gt 1 ]; then
            echo "Multiple input options detected:"
            for i in "${!input_options[@]}"; do
                echo "  $((i+1)). ${input_options[$i]}"
            done
            echo ""
            read -p "Choose input source (1-${#input_options[@]}): " choice
            if [[ "$choice" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$choice" -ge 1 ] && [ "$choice" -le ${#input_options[@]} ]; then
                input_source="${input_options[$((choice-1))]}"
            else
                input_source="${input_options[0]}"
            fi
        elif [ ${#input_options[@]} -eq 1 ]; then
            input_source="${input_options[0]}"
            echo "✓ Selected input: ${input_source}"
        fi
        
        # Use the selected input source directly
        input_source="$input_source"
        
        if [ -n "$input_source" ]; then
            # Use the selected input source for gain control
            input_control="$input_source"
            input_pair="$input_source"
            has_input_gain=1
            echo "✓ Selected input: $input_source"
            
            # Check if the input control (PCM or fallback) has a mute/capture switch
            has_input_mute=0
            if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$input_control'" | grep -q "cswitch"; then
                has_input_mute=1
                echo "✓ Input mute control detected on $input_control"
            else
                echo "• No input mute control detected on $input_control"
            fi
            
            # Actually switch ALSA to use the selected input source
            echo "Switching to $input_source input..."
            
            # Find the capture source control name dynamically
            capture_source_control=$(amixer -c "$input_card" scontents 2>/dev/null | grep -i "capture source" | head -1 | sed "s/.*'\([^']*\)'.*/\1/")
            if [ -n "$capture_source_control" ]; then
                echo "Setting $capture_source_control to: $input_source"
                amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$capture_source_control" "$input_source" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            fi
            
            # Then enable capture on that input
            echo "Enabling capture on: $input_source"
            amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$input_source" cap >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$input_source" 80% >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            echo "✓ Input switched to $input_source"
        else
            echo "• No input volume controls detected"
            has_input_gain=0
            has_input_mute=0
        fi
        
        # For cards with only physical controls (no software gain), don't use ALSA mute
        # Let the synth handle mute instead
        if [ "$has_input_gain" -eq 0 ]; then
            has_input_mute=0
            echo "• Using synth mute (no software input controls detected)"
        fi
    fi

    echo ""
    echo "=== Output Device Setup ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Step 2: Connect the USB audio device you want to use for output"
    echo "(or just press Enter if using the same device for input and output)"
    read -p "Press Enter when your output device is connected..." _
    echo "Scanning for output interface..."; sleep 2
    echo "Available devices:"; cat /proc/asound/cards; echo ""; sleep 1

    # Prefer a device that has playback capability and is not the chosen input
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*\[([^]]+)\]: ]]; then
            local card_num="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            local card_name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            if [ "$card_num" != "$input_card" ] && aplay -l | grep -q "card $card_num:"; then
                output_card="$card_num"; output_name="$card_name"; break
            fi
        fi
    done < /proc/asound/cards

    # If none found, use the same card for both
    if [ -z "$output_card" ]; then
        output_card="$input_card"; output_name="$input_name"
        echo "No separate output found; using same card for input and output"
    fi

    echo "✓ Using output: hw:$output_card ($output_name)"; show_device_info "$output_card" "$output_name" "output"


    echo "INPUT_CARD=$input_card" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_NAME=$input_name" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_SOURCE=$input_source" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_CONTROL=$input_control" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_PAIR=$input_pair" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "OUTPUT_CARD=$output_card" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "OUTPUT_NAME=$output_name" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "HAS_INPUT_GAIN=$has_input_gain" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "HAS_INPUT_MUTE=$has_input_mute" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo ""
    echo "=== Configuration Complete ==="
    echo "✓ Input:  hw:$input_card ($input_name)"
    if [ -n "$input_source" ]; then
        echo "  Source: $input_source"
    fi
    echo "✓ Output: hw:$output_card ($output_name)"
    if [ "$has_input_gain" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✓ Input gain control: $input_control"
    else
        echo "• No input gain control detected"
    fi
    if [ "$has_input_mute" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✓ Input mute control: $input_control"
    else
        echo "• No input mute control detected"
    fi
    echo ""
}

echo "Preparing audio system..."
killall jackd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
killall sclang >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 2

detect_generic_devices
source "$CONFIG_FILE"

echo "Starting audio system..."

jackd -P75 -d alsa -C hw:$INPUT_CARD -P hw:$OUTPUT_CARD -r 44100 -p 1024 -n 3 -S >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 3
if ! pgrep jackd > /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Audio system failed to start."
    exit 1
fi
echo "✓ Audio system ready"

# Set and export capability flags and input details to the app environment
HAS_INPUT_GAIN=$has_input_gain
HAS_INPUT_MUTE=$has_input_mute
INPUT_CARD=$input_card
INPUT_SOURCE=$input_source
INPUT_CONTROL=$input_control
INPUT_PAIR=$input_pair
export HAS_INPUT_GAIN
export HAS_INPUT_MUTE
export INPUT_CARD
export INPUT_SOURCE
export INPUT_CONTROL
export INPUT_PAIR


# Launch SuperCollider application
echo "Starting application..."
exec sclang "$HOME/UHJ-Pi/supercollider/app/UHJ_v23_GEN_PAIR.scd"
```

```shellscript
    echo "✓ Output: hw:$output_card ($output_name)"
    if [ "$has_input_gain" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✓ Input gain control: $input_control"
    else
        echo "• No input gain control detected"
    fi
    if [ "$has_input_mute" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✓ Input mute control: $input_control"
    else
        echo "• No input mute control detected"
    fi
    echo ""
}

echo "Preparing audio system..."
killall jackd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
killall sclang >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 2

detect_generic_devices
source "$CONFIG_FILE"

echo "Starting audio system..."

jackd -P75 -d alsa -C hw:$INPUT_CARD -P hw:$OUTPUT_CARD -r 44100 -p 1024 -n 3 -S >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 3
if ! pgrep jackd > /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Audio system failed to start."

fi
echo "✓ Audio system ready"

INPUT_SOURCE=$input_source

export INPUT_SOURCE
export INPUT_CONTROL
export INPUT_PAIR
```

```shellscript
#!/usr/bin/env bash

CONFIG_FILE="$HOME/.uhj-generic-audio.conf"

# Main dialog menu with hidden options
show_menu() {
    while true; do
        choice=$(dialog --no-lines --no-shadow --title "UHJ-Pi Audio System" --inputmenu "Choose your mode:" 0 0 2 \
            "1" "Live Input Mode" \
            "2" "Player Mode" 2>&1 >/dev/tty)
        
        case $choice in
            "1")
                echo "Starting Live Input Mode..."
                break  # Exit the menu loop and proceed with live input setup
                ;;
            "2")
                echo "Starting Player Mode..."
                exec "$HOME/UHJ-Pi/start-pla.sh"
                ;;
            "b"|"B")
                echo "Starting Bluetooth headtracker setup..."
                exec /usr/local/bin/ble-ht
                ;;
            "r"|"R")
                if dialog --title "Reset System" --yesno "This will perform a COMPLETE system reset.\n\nAre you sure?" 0 0; then
                    echo "Starting system reset..."
                    exec /usr/local/bin/reset-pi
                fi
                ;;
            "")
                # User cancelled or pressed ESC
                echo "Exiting..."
                exit 0
                ;;
        esac
    done
}

# Run the menu
show_menu

echo "Starting UHJ-Pi live input audio setup..."

show_device_info() {
    local card_num=$1
    local card_name=$2
    local device_type=$3  # "input" or "output"
    
    echo "✓ Selected: $card_name"
    
    # Show only relevant channel count for the device type
    if [ "$device_type" = "input" ]; then
        # Get input channel count from stream info (most reliable)
        local input_channels=$(cat "/proc/asound/card$card_num/stream0" 2>/dev/null | grep -A 20 "Capture:" | grep "Channels:" | head -1 | grep -o "[0-9]*" || echo "2")
        if [ -n "$input_channels" ] && [ "$input_channels" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "  Inputs: $input_channels channels"
        fi
    elif [ "$device_type" = "output" ]; then
        # Get output channel count from stream info (most reliable)
        local output_channels=$(cat "/proc/asound/card$card_num/stream0" 2>/dev/null | grep -A 20 "Playback:" | grep "Channels:" | head -1 | grep -o "[0-9]*" || echo "2")
        if [ -n "$output_channels" ] && [ "$output_channels" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "  Outputs: $output_channels channels"
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
}

show_input_options() {
    local card_num=$1
    local card_name=$2
    echo "  Available inputs:"
    
    # Get input options from amixer
    local input_options=()
    local control_info=$(amixer -c "$card_num" scontents 2>/dev/null)
    
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ ^Simple\ mixer\ control\ \'([^\']+)\' ]]; then
            local control_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            # Check if this control has capture volume
            if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then
                # Check if it has capture channels (not just playback)
                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$control_name'" | grep -q "Capture channels"; then
                    input_options+=("$control_name")
                fi
            fi
        fi
    done <<< "$control_info"
    
    if [ ${#input_options[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        for option in "${input_options[@]}"; do
            echo "    • $option"
        done
    else
        echo "    • No software-controllable inputs detected"
    fi
}

show_output_options() {
    local card_num=$1
    local card_name=$2
    echo "  Available outputs:"
    
    # Get output options from aplay
    output_devices=$(aplay -l | grep "card $card_num:" | sed 's/.*card [0-9]*: \([^,]*\).*/\1/')
    if [ -n "$output_devices" ]; then
        echo "$output_devices" | while read -r device; do
            echo "    • $device"
        done
    else
        echo "    • No output devices detected"
    fi
}

detect_generic_devices() {
    input_card=""
    input_name=""
    output_card=""
    output_name=""

    echo "=== Input Device Setup ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Step 1: Connect the USB audio device you want to use for input"
    read -p "Press Enter when your input device is connected..." _
    echo "Scanning for audio devices..."
    sleep 2

    # Prefer a device that has capture capability
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*\[([^]]+)\]: ]]; then
            local card_num="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            local card_name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            if arecord -l | grep -q "card $card_num:"; then
                input_card="$card_num"; input_name="$card_name"; break
            fi
        fi
    done < /proc/asound/cards

    # Check if any input device was found
    if [ -z "$input_card" ]; then
        echo "❌ No input audio device found!"
        echo "Please connect a USB audio device and try again."
        echo ""
        read -p "Press Enter to retry..." _
        detect_generic_devices  # Recursive call to retry
        return
    fi
    echo "✓ Using input: hw:$input_card ($input_name)"; show_device_info "$input_card" "$input_name" "input"

    # Detect available input pairs and their controls FIRST
    input_source=""
    input_control=""
    input_pair=""
    has_input_gain=0
    
    if command -v amixer >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Detecting input options on $input_name..."
        
        # Parse amixer output to find input pairs with capture volume
        input_options=()
        control_info=$(amixer -c "$input_card" scontents 2>/dev/null)
        
        # Look for controls with capture volume (cvolume)
        seen_controls=()
        while IFS= read -r line; do
            if [[ $line =~ ^Simple\ mixer\ control\ \'([^\']+)\' ]]; then
                full_control_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
                control_name=$(echo "$full_control_name" | sed 's/,[0-9]*$//')
                
                # Skip if we've already processed this control name
                if [[ " ${seen_controls[@]} " =~ " ${control_name} " ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                
                # Skip PCM controls - these are routing/processing, not physical inputs
                if [[ "$control_name" == "PCM" ]] || [[ "$control_name" == *"PCM"* ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                
                # Skip Speaker controls - these are output controls, not input sources
                if [[ "$control_name" == "Speaker" ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                
                # Skip enum-only controls that are routing selectors (like "PCM Capture Source")
                # but keep physical inputs like "IEC958 In" even if they're enum
                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "Capabilities.*enum" && ! echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then
                    # Allow IEC958 In (SPDIF) as it's a physical input
                    if [[ "$control_name" != "IEC958 In" ]]; then
                        continue
                    fi
                fi
                
                # Check if this control has capture volume (cvolume) - needed for input faders
                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then
                    # Check if it has capture channels (not just playback)
                    if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "Capture channels"; then
                        # Get channel info to distinguish between stereo/mono
                        local channel_info=$(echo "$control_info" | grep -A 5 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep "Capture channels:" | head -1)
                        if echo "$channel_info" | grep -q "Front Left - Front Right"; then
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        elif echo "$channel_info" | grep -q "Mono"; then
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        else
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        fi
                    fi
                fi
            fi
        done <<< "$control_info"
        
        # Always ask user to choose if multiple options available
        if [ ${#input_options[@]} -gt 1 ]; then
            echo "Multiple input options detected:"
            for i in "${!input_options[@]}"; do
                echo "  $((i+1)). ${input_options[$i]}"
            done
            echo ""
            read -p "Choose input source (1-${#input_options[@]}): " choice
            if [[ "$choice" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$choice" -ge 1 ] && [ "$choice" -le ${#input_options[@]} ]; then
                input_source="${input_options[$((choice-1))]}"
            else
                input_source="${input_options[0]}"
            fi
        elif [ ${#input_options[@]} -eq 1 ]; then
            input_source="${input_options[0]}"
            echo "✓ Selected input: ${input_source}"
        fi
        
        # Use the selected input source directly
        input_source="$input_source"
        
        if [ -n "$input_source" ]; then
            # Use the selected input source for gain control
            input_control="$input_source"
            input_pair="$input_source"
            has_input_gain=1
            echo "✓ Selected input: $input_source"
            
            # Check if the input control (PCM or fallback) has a mute/capture switch
            has_input_mute=0
            if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$input_control'" | grep -q "cswitch"; then
                has_input_mute=1
                echo "✓ Input mute control detected on $input_control"
            else
                echo "• No input mute control detected on $input_control"
            fi
            
            # Actually switch ALSA to use the selected input source
            echo "Switching to $input_source input..."
            
            # Find the capture source control name dynamically
            capture_source_control=$(amixer -c "$input_card" scontents 2>/dev/null | grep -i "capture source" | head -1 | sed "s/.*'\([^']*\)'.*/\1/")
            if [ -n "$capture_source_control" ]; then
                echo "Setting $capture_source_control to: $input_source"
                amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$capture_source_control" "$input_source" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            fi
            
            # Then enable capture on that input
            echo "Enabling capture on: $input_source"
            amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$input_source" cap >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$input_source" 80% >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            echo "✓ Input switched to $input_source"
        else
            echo "• No input volume controls detected"
            has_input_gain=0
            has_input_mute=0
        fi
        
        # For cards with only physical controls (no software gain), don't use ALSA mute
        # Let the synth handle mute instead
        if [ "$has_input_gain" -eq 0 ]; then
            has_input_mute=0
            echo "• Using synth mute (no software input controls detected)"
        fi
    fi

    echo ""
    echo "=== Output Device Setup ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Step 2: Connect the USB audio device you want to use for output"
    echo "(or just press Enter if using the same device for input and output)"
    read -p "Press Enter when your output device is connected..." _
    echo "Scanning for output interface..."; sleep 2
    echo "Available devices:"; cat /proc/asound/cards; echo ""; sleep 1

    # Prefer a device that has playback capability and is not the chosen input
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*\[([^]]+)\]: ]]; then
            local card_num="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            local card_name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            if [ "$card_num" != "$input_card" ] && aplay -l | grep -q "card $card_num:"; then
                output_card="$card_num"; output_name="$card_name"; break
            fi
        fi
    done < /proc/asound/cards

    # If none found, use the same card for both
    if [ -z "$output_card" ]; then
        output_card="$input_card"; output_name="$input_name"
        echo "No separate output found; using same card for input and output"
    fi

    echo "✓ Using output: hw:$output_card ($output_name)"; show_device_info "$output_card" "$output_name" "output"


    echo "INPUT_CARD=$input_card" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_NAME=$input_name" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_SOURCE=$input_source" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_CONTROL=$input_control" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_PAIR=$input_pair" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "OUTPUT_CARD=$output_card" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "OUTPUT_NAME=$output_name" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "HAS_INPUT_GAIN=$has_input_gain" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "HAS_INPUT_MUTE=$has_input_mute" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo ""
    echo "=== Configuration Complete ==="
    echo "✓ Input:  hw:$input_card ($input_name)"
    if [ -n "$input_source" ]; then
        echo "  Source: $input_source"
    fi
    echo "✓ Output: hw:$output_card ($output_name)"
    if [ "$has_input_gain" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✓ Input gain control: $input_control"
    else
        echo "• No input gain control detected"
    fi
    if [ "$has_input_mute" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✓ Input mute control: $input_control"
    else
        echo "• No input mute control detected"
    fi
    echo ""
}

echo "Preparing audio system..."
killall jackd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
killall sclang >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 2

detect_generic_devices
source "$CONFIG_FILE"

echo "Starting audio system..."

jackd -P75 -d alsa -C hw:$INPUT_CARD -P hw:$OUTPUT_CARD -r 44100 -p 1024 -n 3 -S >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 3
if ! pgrep jackd > /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Audio system failed to start."
    exit 1
fi

INPUT_SOURCE=$input_source

export INPUT_SOURCE
```

```shellscript
        echo "❌ No input audio device found!"
        echo "Please connect a USB audio device and try again."
        echo ""
        read -p "Press Enter to retry..." _
        detect_generic_devices  # Recursive call to retry
        return
    fi
    echo "✓ Using input: hw:$input_card ($input_name)"; show_device_info "$input_card" "$input_name" "input"

    # Detect available input pairs and their controls FIRST
    input_source=""
    input_control=""
    input_pair=""
    has_input_gain=0
    
    if command -v amixer >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Detecting input options on $input_name..."
        
        # Parse amixer output to find input pairs with capture volume
        input_options=()
        control_info=$(amixer -c "$input_card" scontents 2>/dev/null)
        
        # Look for controls with capture volume (cvolume)
        seen_controls=()
        while IFS= read -r line; do
            if [[ $line =~ ^Simple\ mixer\ control\ \'([^\']+)\' ]]; then
                full_control_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
                control_name=$(echo "$full_control_name" | sed 's/,[0-9]*$//')
                
                # Skip if we've already processed this control name
                if [[ " ${seen_controls[@]} " =~ " ${control_name} " ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                
                # Skip PCM controls - these are routing/processing, not physical inputs
                if [[ "$control_name" == "PCM" ]] || [[ "$control_name" == *"PCM"* ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                
                # Skip Speaker controls - these are output controls, not input sources
                if [[ "$control_name" == "Speaker" ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                
                # Skip enum-only controls that are routing selectors (like "PCM Capture Source")
                # but keep physical inputs like "IEC958 In" even if they're enum
                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "Capabilities.*enum" && ! echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then
                    # Allow IEC958 In (SPDIF) as it's a physical input
                    if [[ "$control_name" != "IEC958 In" ]]; then
                        continue
                    fi
                fi
                
                # Check if this control has capture volume (cvolume) - needed for input faders
                if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "cvolume"; then
                    # Check if it has capture channels (not just playback)
                    if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep -q "Capture channels"; then
                        # Get channel info to distinguish between stereo/mono
                        local channel_info=$(echo "$control_info" | grep -A 5 "Simple mixer control '$full_control_name'" | grep "Capture channels:" | head -1)
                        if echo "$channel_info" | grep -q "Front Left - Front Right"; then
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        elif echo "$channel_info" | grep -q "Mono"; then
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        else
                            input_options+=("$control_name")
                            seen_controls+=("$control_name")
                        fi
                    fi
                fi
            fi
        done <<< "$control_info"
        
        # Always ask user to choose if multiple options available
        if [ ${#input_options[@]} -gt 1 ]; then
            echo "Multiple input options detected:"
            for i in "${!input_options[@]}"; do
                echo "  $((i+1)). ${input_options[$i]}"
            done
            echo ""
            read -p "Choose input source (1-${#input_options[@]}): " choice
            if [[ "$choice" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$choice" -ge 1 ] && [ "$choice" -le ${#input_options[@]} ]; then
                input_source="${input_options[$((choice-1))]}"
            else
                input_source="${input_options[0]}"
            fi
        elif [ ${#input_options[@]} -eq 1 ]; then
            input_source="${input_options[0]}"
            echo "✓ Selected input: ${input_source}"
        fi
        
        # Use the selected input source directly
        input_source="$input_source"
        
        if [ -n "$input_source" ]; then
            # Use the selected input source for gain control
            input_control="$input_source"
            input_pair="$input_source"
            has_input_gain=1
            echo "✓ Selected input: $input_source"
            
            # Check if the input control (PCM or fallback) has a mute/capture switch
            has_input_mute=0
            if echo "$control_info" | grep -A 20 "Simple mixer control '$input_control'" | grep -q "cswitch"; then
                has_input_mute=1
                echo "✓ Input mute control detected on $input_control"
            else
                echo "• No input mute control detected on $input_control"
            fi
            
            # Actually switch ALSA to use the selected input source
            echo "Switching to $input_source input..."
            
            # Find the capture source control name dynamically
            capture_source_control=$(amixer -c "$input_card" scontents 2>/dev/null | grep -i "capture source" | head -1 | sed "s/.*'\([^']*\)'.*/\1/")
            if [ -n "$capture_source_control" ]; then
                echo "Setting $capture_source_control to: $input_source"
                amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$capture_source_control" "$input_source" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            fi
            
            # Then enable capture on that input
            echo "Enabling capture on: $input_source"
            amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$input_source" cap >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            amixer -c "$input_card" sset "$input_source" 80% >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            echo "✓ Input switched to $input_source"
        else
            echo "• No input volume controls detected"
            has_input_gain=0
            has_input_mute=0
        fi
        
        # For cards with only physical controls (no software gain), don't use ALSA mute
        # Let the synth handle mute instead
        if [ "$has_input_gain" -eq 0 ]; then
            has_input_mute=0
            echo "• Using synth mute (no software input controls detected)"
        fi
    fi

    echo ""
    echo "=== Output Device Setup ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Step 2: Connect the USB audio device you want to use for output"
    echo "(or just press Enter if using the same device for input and output)"
    read -p "Press Enter when your output device is connected..." _
    echo "Scanning for output interface..."; sleep 2
    echo "Available devices:"; cat /proc/asound/cards; echo ""; sleep 1

    # Prefer a device that has playback capability and is not the chosen input
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*\[([^]]+)\]: ]]; then
            local card_num="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            local card_name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            if [ "$card_num" != "$input_card" ] && aplay -l | grep -q "card $card_num:"; then
                output_card="$card_num"; output_name="$card_name"; break
            fi
        fi
    done < /proc/asound/cards

    # If none found, use the same card for both
    if [ -z "$output_card" ]; then
        output_card="$input_card"; output_name="$input_name"
        echo "No separate output found; using same card for input and output"
    fi

    echo "✓ Using output: hw:$output_card ($output_name)"; show_device_info "$output_card" "$output_name" "output"


    echo "INPUT_CARD=$input_card" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_NAME=$input_name" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_SOURCE=$input_source" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_CONTROL=$input_control" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "INPUT_PAIR=$input_pair" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "OUTPUT_CARD=$output_card" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "OUTPUT_NAME=$output_name" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "HAS_INPUT_GAIN=$has_input_gain" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "HAS_INPUT_MUTE=$has_input_mute" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo ""
    echo "=== Configuration Complete ==="
    echo "✓ Input:  hw:$input_card ($input_name)"
    if [ -n "$input_source" ]; then
        echo "  Source: $input_source"
    fi
    echo "✓ Output: hw:$output_card ($output_name)"
    if [ "$has_input_gain" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✓ Input gain control: $input_control"
    else
        echo "• No input gain control detected"
    fi
    if [ "$has_input_mute" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✓ Input mute control: $input_control"
    else
        echo "• No input mute control detected"
    fi
    echo ""
}

echo "Preparing audio system..."
killall jackd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
killall sclang >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 2

detect_generic_devices
source "$CONFIG_FILE"

echo "Starting audio system..."

jackd -P75 -d alsa -C hw:$INPUT_CARD -P hw:$OUTPUT_CARD -r 44100 -p 1024 -n 3 -S >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 3
if ! pgrep jackd > /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Audio system failed to start."
    exit 1
fi
echo "✓ Audio system ready"

# Set and export capability flags and input details to the app environment
HAS_INPUT_GAIN=$has_input_gain
HAS_INPUT_MUTE=$has_input_mute
INPUT_CARD=$input_card
INPUT_SOURCE=$input_source
INPUT_CONTROL=$input_control
INPUT_PAIR=$input_pair
export HAS_INPUT_GAIN
export HAS_INPUT_MUTE
export INPUT_CARD
export INPUT_SOURCE
export INPUT_CONTROL
export INPUT_PAIR


# Launch SuperCollider application
echo "Starting application..."
exec sclang "$HOME/UHJ-Pi/supercollider/app/UHJ_v23_GEN_PAIR.scd"
```

**Cursor**

The reason your changes aren't updating is likely due to **shell caching** or **file system caching**. Here are the most common causes:

1. **Shell Command Hash Cache**: Bash caches the location of executable files. If you're running `./test-menu.sh`, bash might be using a cached version. Try:
   - `bash test-menu.sh` (explicit bash execution)
   - `hash -r` (clear bash command hash cache)
   - Use the full path: `/home/michael-uwins/UHJ-Pi/test-menu.sh`

2. **File System Sync Issues**: Sometimes changes aren't immediately written to disk. Try:
   - `sync` command to force filesystem sync
   - Wait a few seconds after saving

3. **Editor vs File System**: Your editor might not be saving immediately, or there could be a sync delay between your editor and the actual file system.

4. **Multiple File Versions**: Check if you have multiple copies of the file or if there are any backup/swap files interfering.

5. **Permissions**: Make sure the file is executable: `chmod +x test-menu.sh`

The most likely culprit is **bash command hash caching** - when you run `./test-menu.sh`, bash remembers where it found that executable and might not re-read it even if you change the content.

Try `bash test-menu.sh` explicitly or run `hash -r` to clear the cache, then try your changes again.

You're thinking of `whiptail`! That's exactly what the Raspberry Pi uses for its setup screens - it has that distinctive dark blue background with red highlights and a much cleaner, more polished look.

`whiptail` is actually a simplified version of `dialog` that's designed to be more user-friendly and has a better default appearance. It's what `raspi-config` uses for all its menus.

```shellscript

echo "Testing menu system..."

    local choice
    choice=$(whiptail --title "UHJ-Pi Mode Selection" \
        --menu "Choose your mode:" 15 60 4 \
        "1" "Live Input Mode" \
        "2" "Player Mode" \
        "B" "Bluetooth Headtracker Setup" \
        "R" "Reset System" \
        3>&1 1>&2 2>&3)

    case $choice in
        "1")
            echo "Starting Live Input Mode..."
            ;;
        "2")
            echo "Starting Player Mode..."
            ;;
        "B"|"b")
            echo "Starting Bluetooth Setup..."
            ;;
        "R"|"r")
            echo "Starting System Reset..."
            ;;
        *)
            echo "No valid choice made"
            ;;
    esac
}

# Show the menu
show_menu
```

For touchscreen-only operation, we need a different approach entirely. Here are the realistic options:

## **Touchscreen Solutions:**

1. **Auto-boot to a default mode** (simplest):
   - Boot directly to Live Input Mode by default
   - User can change mode through the app's own UI once it's running
   - No menu needed at boot time

2. **Simple touch-based menu**:
   - Use a basic GUI with large touch targets
   - Could use `zenity` (if available) or a simple web-based menu
   - But this adds complexity and dependencies

3. **Physical button approach**:
   - GPIO button that cycles through modes
   - Or multiple physical buttons for different modes

4. **File-based mode selection**:
   - Create a simple file that the boot script reads
   - User could edit this file via SSH or a simple web interface
   - Boot script reads the file and launches appropriate mode

## **My Recommendation:**
Go with **option 1** - auto-boot to Live Input Mode by default. This is the most reliable approach because:
- It always works, regardless of input devices
- The user can switch modes from within the app once it's running
- No risk of getting stuck at boot
- Simplest to implement and maintain

Ah, that's a brilliant idea! Much simpler and more elegant - the close button becomes a "switch mode" button that:

1. **Shuts down the current app**
2. **Launches the other version**

So:
- **Live Input Mode** → close button → launches **Player Mode**
- **Player Mode** → close button → launches **Live Input Mode**

This gives you a perfect toggle between the two modes without any complex menus or dialogs. Let me implement this:

```supercollider
// Function to find smart default artist and album
~findSmartDefaults = {
    var isUSB = if(~sourceToggleBtn.notNil) { ~sourceToggleBtn.value == 1 } { false };
    var basePath, artists, foundArtist, foundAlbum;
    
    // Get base path based on source
    if(isUSB, {
        basePath = ~detectUSBDir.value;
        if(basePath.isEmpty or: { basePath == "/tmp/" }, {
            // No USB drive, try ATK
            basePath = Atk.userSoundsDir ++ "/uhj";
        }, {
            // USB drive found, get content directory
            var usbEntries = PathName(basePath).entries.select { |entry| entry.isFolder };
            basePath = if(usbEntries.size > 0) { usbEntries[0].fullPath } { basePath };
        });
    }, {
        basePath = Atk.userSoundsDir ++ "/uhj";
    });
    
    // Get available artists
    artists = PathName(basePath).entries.select { |entry| entry.isFolder };
    
    if(artists.isEmpty, {
        // No artists found
        foundArtist = nil;
        foundAlbum = "..."
    }, {
        // Look for preferred album first
        foundArtist = nil;
        foundAlbum = nil;
        
        artists.do { |artist|
            var artistPath = artist.fullPath;
            var albums = PathName(artistPath).entries.select { |entry| entry.isFolder };
            var looseFiles = PathName(artistPath).entries.select { |entry| 
                entry.isFile and: { 
                    var ext = entry.extension.asString.toLower;
                    (ext == "wav") or: (ext == "flac") or: (ext == "mp3") or: (ext == "aif") or: (ext == "aiff") or: (ext == "ogg") or: (ext == "m4a");
                };
            };
            
            // Check if preferred album exists
            var preferredAlbum = albums.detect { |album| 
                album.folderName.asString.toUpper == ~preferredDefaultAlbum.toUpper 
            };
            
            if(preferredAlbum.notNil, {
                foundArtist = artist.folderName.asString.toUpper;
                foundAlbum = preferredAlbum.folderName.asString.toUpper;
            }, {
                // No preferred album in this artist, use first available as fallback only if no preferred album found yet
                if(foundArtist.isNil, {
                    foundArtist = artist.folderName.asString.toUpper;
                    if(albums.size > 0, {
                        foundAlbum = albums[0].folderName.asString.toUpper;
                    }, {
                        if(looseFiles.size > 0, {
                            foundAlbum = "<NO ALBUMS>";
                        }, {
                            foundAlbum = "...";
                        });
                    });
                });
            });
        };
    });
    
    [foundArtist, foundAlbum];
};

// Find artwork file with priority search
~findArtworkFile = { |albumPath, currentTrackPath|
    var foundPath, artworkNames, extensions;
    
    "findArtworkFile called with: ".post; albumPath.postln; currentTrackPath.postln;
    
    // If we have a current track path, try FLAC artwork first
    if(currentTrackPath.notNil, {
        "Trying FLAC artwork extraction...".postln;
        foundPath = ~findArtworkForTrack.value(currentTrackPath, albumPath);
        "FLAC artwork result: ".post; foundPath.postln;
        if(foundPath.notNil, {
            "findArtworkFile returning FLAC artwork: ".post; foundPath.postln;
            // Return the FLAC artwork path immediately
            foundPath;
        });
        // If FLAC artwork extraction failed, continue to fallback
    });
    
    // Fall back to original folder artwork search (only if FLAC artwork wasn't found)
    
    if(foundPath.isNil, {
        // Priority order for artwork file names
        artworkNames = ["artwork", "cover", "folder"];
        // Supported image extensions
        extensions = ["png", "jpg", "jpeg"];
        
        // Search through all combinations of names and extensions
        artworkNames.do { |name|
            extensions.do { |ext|
                if(foundPath.isNil, {
                    var testPath = albumPath +/+ (name ++ "." ++ ext);
                    if(File.exists(testPath), {
                        foundPath = testPath;
                    });
                });
            };
        };
        
        // If no specific artwork found, look for any .png or .jpg file
        if(foundPath.isNil, {
            var entries = PathName(albumPath).entries.select { |entry| 
                entry.isFile and: { 
                    var ext = entry.extension.asString.toLower;
                    (ext == "png") or: (ext == "jpg") or: (ext == "jpeg");
                };
            };
            if(entries.size > 0, {
                foundPath = entries[0].fullPath;
            });
        });
    });
    
    foundPath;
};

// FLAC metadata functions
~getFLACMetadata = { |filePath|
    var command, output, lines, metadata, line, key, value, colonIndex;
    command = "metaflac --export-tags-to=- \"" ++ filePath ++ "\" 2>/dev/null";
    output = unixCmdGetStdOut(command);
    if(output.isEmpty, { ^nil });
    
    lines = output.split($\n);
    metadata = Dictionary.new;
    
    lines.do { |line|
        if(line.notEmpty, {
            colonIndex = line.find("=");
            if(colonIndex.notNil, {
                key = line.copyRange(0, colonIndex - 1);
                value = line.copyRange(colonIndex + 1, line.size - 1);
                metadata.put(key, value);
            });
        });
    };
    
    metadata;
};

~getFLACTrackNumber = { |filePath|
    var metadata, trackNumber, slashIndex;
    metadata = ~getFLACMetadata.value(filePath);
    if(metadata.isNil, { ^nil });
    
    trackNumber = metadata["TRACKNUMBER"];
    if(trackNumber.isNil, { ^nil });
    
    slashIndex = trackNumber.find("/");
    if(slashIndex.notNil, {
        trackNumber = trackNumber.copyRange(0, slashIndex - 1);
    });
    
    trackNumber.asInteger;
};

~extractFLACArtwork = { |filePath, outputPath|
    // Extract artwork from FLAC file using metaflac
    var command, success;
    command = "metaflac --export-picture-to=\"" ++ outputPath ++ "\" \"" ++ filePath ++ "\" 2>/dev/null && echo 'SUCCESS'";
    // Use unixCmdGetStdOut and check if SUCCESS is in output or file exists
    success = (unixCmdGetStdOut(command).contains("SUCCESS")) or: File.exists(outputPath);
    success;
};

~findArtworkForTrack = { |currentTrackPath, albumPath|
    // Find artwork with priority: track -> album -> folder -> default
    var artworkPath, tempPath, firstFlacPath, folderArtwork, result;
    
    "findArtworkForTrack called with: ".post; currentTrackPath.postln; albumPath.postln;
    
    result = nil;
    tempPath = "/tmp/track_artwork.jpg";
    
    // 1. Try current track artwork
    if(result.isNil and: File.exists(currentTrackPath) and: { 
        var ext = PathName(currentTrackPath).extension.asString.toLower;
        ext == "flac";
    }, {
        "Trying to extract from current FLAC track...".postln;
        if(~extractFLACArtwork.value(currentTrackPath, tempPath), {
            "SUCCESS: Extracted artwork from current track".postln;
            "Returning artwork path: ".post; tempPath.postln;
            result = tempPath;
        }, {
            "FAILED: Could not extract from current track".postln;
        });
    }, {
        "Current track is not FLAC or doesn't exist".postln;
    });
    
    // 2. Try first FLAC file in album
    if(result.isNil and: File.exists(albumPath), {
        var pn = PathName(albumPath);
        var flacFiles = pn.entries.select { |f| 
            f.isFile and: { f.extension.asString.toLower == "flac" };
        };
        if(flacFiles.size > 0, {
            firstFlacPath = flacFiles[0].fullPath;
            "Trying to extract from first FLAC in album: ".post; firstFlacPath.postln;
            if(~extractFLACArtwork.value(firstFlacPath, tempPath), {
                "SUCCESS: Extracted artwork from first FLAC in album".postln;
                result = tempPath;
            }, {
                "FAILED: Could not extract from first FLAC in album".postln;
            });
        });
    });
    
    // 3. Try folder artwork (cover.jpg, folder.jpg, etc.)
    if(result.isNil and: File.exists(albumPath), {
        var pn = PathName(albumPath);
        var imageFiles = pn.entries.select { |f| 
            f.isFile and: { 
                var ext = f.extension.asString.toLower;
                (ext == "jpg") or: (ext == "jpeg") or: (ext == "png") or: (ext == "gif") or: (ext == "bmp");
            };
        };
        // Look for common artwork filenames
        folderArtwork = imageFiles.detect { |f|
            var name = f.fileNameWithoutExtension.asString.toLower;
            (name == "cover") or: (name == "folder") or: (name == "album") or: (name == "artwork");
        };
        if(folderArtwork.notNil, {
            "SUCCESS: Found folder artwork: ".post; folderArtwork.fullPath.postln;
            result = folderArtwork.fullPath;
        }, {
            // If no specific artwork file, use first image
            if(imageFiles.size > 0, {
                "SUCCESS: Found generic folder image: ".post; imageFiles[0].fullPath.postln;
                result = imageFiles[0].fullPath;
            });
        });
    });
    
    // 4. Return result (nil if no artwork found, will fall back to UHJ-Pi default)
    if(result.isNil, {
        "No artwork found".postln;
    }, {
        "FINAL RESULT: ".post; result.postln;
    });
    result;
};
```
